shared_elements: upright rectangular slab with rounded top carved in low relief
dense field of script-like signs organized in rows/registers
framing border around the carved field
figural/anthropomorphic imagery incorporated into the design
justification: Both are round-topped upright slabs bearing low-relief writing systems laid out in bordered horizontal registers, and both mix pictorial/anthropomorphic content with script, which gives a similar overall gestalt. But A depicts a specific figural scene — a standing profile figure facing a bowing offerant with an offering stand between them, above bands of linear text — whereas B is entirely a grid of blocky, rounded, face-filled glyph cartouches with no narrative scene, and the sign forms and figure conventions (slender profile bodies vs. compressed frontal faces) share no conventions.
